modes.cue_notes: Balancing on the standing leg with the bottom hand grounded on the floor or a block, lift the back leg to hip height and stack the top hip over the bottom, opening the chest and reaching the top arm to the sky.

breathing_cues.entering: Exhale to shift weight into the standing leg and float the lifted leg to hip height as the bottom hand finds the floor.
breathing_cues.holding: Steady breath to hold the balance; inhale to lift through the top arm and open the chest, exhale to root the standing foot.
breathing_cues.exiting: Exhale to lower the lifted leg and return to a forward fold or straighten back to standing.

prop_free_variation: Ground the bottom hand on the floor directly under the shoulder instead of using a block if hamstrings and balance allow.
